# 用 AI 员工建立每周 GEO 审计与执行循环

作者：@OlgaPechnenko  
日期：2026-11-04（北京时间）  
来源：[X原帖](https://x.com/OlgaPechnenko/status/2117785992337744001)  
分类：研究案例

## 中文全文

你说到复利和建立系统这一点，确实有道理。

我让自己的 AI GEO 员工做了一次 GEO 审计，把业务目标告诉它们。它们执行了提出的所有建议，现在还会每隔 7 天检查并落实一次。

这里是它们自 10 月 26 日完成 GEO 审计修复后持续追踪的一些事项。所以，追踪时间才刚刚 7 天左右。

这一切都运行在我网站的“大脑”上，因此它们能每天添加 GEO 审计建议创建、帮助网站被发现的页面。这才叫一个系统：）

一个月后我再来和你交流——到时候比较一下进展！

## 外文原文

you are on to something here about compounding and having a system. 

I had my AI GEO employees do a GEO audit, gave them my business goal, and they implemented all they suggested - and now they will be checking/implementing every 7 days. 

Here are some of the things they have been tracking since GEO audit fixes were done on 10/26. So barely 7 days of tracking. 

It's all running on my site's brain, so they are able to add pages GEO audit recommended to be found on a daily. Talk about a system:) 

Will check in with you in a month - let's compare how it's going!
